summary: Mid-market analytics SaaS evaluating Redwood for chat-based in-app assistant and semantic search. Started with Hosted API (fast eval) and moving toward Dedicated if POC economics and security controls align. Priority: keep p50 token latency <200ms for chat; sustain 100 qps for embeddings-heavy search; minimize per-token cost on high-volume query flows.
requirements: Workload: chat + embeddings + on-demand reranker. Targets: p50 latency 150-200ms, 100 qps sustained embeddings, batch windows acceptable up to 50ms for non-interactive rerank. Cost sensitivity: want 30-50% unit cost reduction vs naive hosted calls. Must support SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration, EU data residency for user transcripts.
poC_details: POC ingest: 1.2M docs (10GB), index with vector store. Test scenarios: support triage (chat), document search (top-k embeddings), nightly rerank jobs. Success metrics: latency SLAs met for 95% requests, quantization/regimen reduces GPU spend by >=35% without >3% answer degradation.
cost_optimization_focus: Scheduling workshop to evaluate batching strategy (prefix vs request-level), KV/prefix caching to cut hot-path tokens, recommended quantization profiles (GPT-like model 4-bit/8-bit shadow tests), and model-routing policies (fallback to smaller model for low-importance queries). Need unit-economics modeling: cost per useful-response, cost per session, projected monthly token volumes.
